code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg]
    # Repeated separator lines define equal-sized cells; use the first cell as the pattern.
    r = rows[0] if rows else h
    c = cols[0] if cols else w
    tile = [row[:c] for row in grid[:r]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(h):
        if i in rows: continue
        ii = (i if i < r else i-r-1) % r
        for j in range(w):
            if j in cols: continue
            jj = (j if j < c else j-c-1) % c
            out[i][j] = tile[ii][jj]
    return out
'''
